revision_history.author: AI workflow agent
revision_history.summary: Initial ratified Phase A.1 B01 data contract incorporating C01-C10, GOV-01, SIM-A1-001 (1406-03-01, day 12), 18-section matrix, canonical shift/duration rules, bilingual labor metrics, Shiraz 34/32 profile + appendix, official numbering, and MET Norway 2.0 forecast contract.

daily_summary_activity_filter.actor_or_source: Stage 3 Supervisor clarification for B04 FR-001
daily_summary_activity_filter.decision_text: When any discipline, contractor, or block filter is selected, a daily summary matches those filters only if one eligible activity source row satisfies them all. Exclude summaries whose matches are split across source rows. Return each matching logical daily report once.

scope_decisions.topic: Raw daily entry vs. derived summary
scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Unit pages capture operational inputs; project daily report aggregates them as a derived summary.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Operational data enters through unit-level sources; the project daily report is a derived summary permitting only authorized project-level metadata, including during revisions.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: coerce_optional_decimal and quantity_measured distinguish 0/0.00 from null/not-measured.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Measured 0/0.00 is valid numeric zero; unset (null) and not-measured remain unknown and are never silently coerced to 0. Supersedes older 033 zero-forbidden text while preserving positive-only domain rules (e.g., pressure/concrete tests).

scope_decisions.topic: Header shift, activity shift & working duration
scope_decisions.observed_behavior: DailyReport used day/night/full enum, activities used shift_1/2/3, Excel hardcoded shift-hours placeholder, man-hours defaulted missing duration to 8h.
scope_decisions.decision_text: One logical daily report per project per local calendar date; list only shifts that actually worked in the header; use identical canonical shift identifiers (1, 2, 3) across header, activity/labor, and date lookup; calculate person-hours from actual working duration per shift; treat missing duration and resulting person-hours as unknown without assuming planned or default hours.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: shiraz_file4_excel.py hardcoded 34 indirect and 32 direct roles and concatenated extra titles onto main tables.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Keep the versioned, configurable project job-title catalog separate from the selectable Shiraz 34/32 reference-form profile; list additional, custom, and historical job titles in a dedicated appendix.

scope_decisions.topic: Single daily sheet vs. multi-sheet workbook
scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Only single-day Excel/PDF existed; multi-sheet date-range workbook was absent.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Phase A.1 requires both a representative single-day report (Excel and PDF) AND a multi-sheet Excel workbook covering a date range. Legacy 367-sheet historical ETL remains outside A.1 under X08.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Reports track actor attribution fields and metadata/aggregation hash fingerprint.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Existing actor attribution block and metadata fingerprint are sufficient for Phase A.1. Certificate-backed PKI digital signatures and whole-report tamper-evidence mechanisms are outside Phase A.1 scope.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: sub_reports exposed Excel export only; standalone discipline PDF was absent.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Phase A.1 requires standalone PDFs for each discipline in addition to discipline-specific Excel exports.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Official report number, project day, wind/ground header output, and MET Norway 3-day forecast were absent.
scope_decisions.decision_text: All three are mandatory in A.1: (a) stable project ID + actual project day (actual start date = day 1) + official report number <projectID>-<projectDay>-<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD> in Solar Hijri project-local date with 2-digit month/day, (b) observed weather/wind/ground from existing weather logs, (c) 3-day forecast at project location from free MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0. Missing values display unknown and are never fabricated.

scope_decisions.topic: Summary approval vs. individual source approvals
scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Unit source submitted/approved states are independent of daily summary approved state.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Unit source submitted/approved states remain independent of daily summary approved state unless an explicit stricter approval gate is ratified.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: Stakeholder/meeting/correspondence workflows belong to A.3.C and weekly/monthly/general reports belong to A.10.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Preserved in total product scope under named owner phases A.3.C and A.10; neither deleted nor closed by A.1 acceptance.

scope_decisions.observed_behavior: No real project-day report is available in the workspace.
scope_decisions.decision_text: Explicitly authorize realistic, clearly labeled synthetic construction workday data using SIM-A1-001 on Solar Hijri 1406-03-01 (project day 12, official report SIM-A1-001-12-1406-03-01). Designated AI workflow agent creates/imports fixture, records internal decision (2026-11-19), and verifies A.1 internally; employer retains final acceptance with named representative and acceptance date recorded during B06 handoff.
